title: Insights into the structural diversity of cembranoids from Sarcophyton glaucum and their bioactivity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4702-4707
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00208G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kuei-Hung Lai, Hsiao-Ling Chung, You-Ying Chen, Li-Guo Zheng, Jui-Hsin Su, Mohamed El-Shazly
This study reports eight cembranoids, including three new compounds, from Sarcophyton glaucum, with compound 8 showing the most potent enhancement of ALP activity (139.41 ± 8.06%) without cytotoxicity.
